title: Bond investment amortization & classification — Lakeshore Insurance
instructions: On January 1, Year 1, Lakeshore Insurance bought Harper Corp. bonds: face **$400,000**, stated rate **5%** paid annually each December 31, maturing in 4 years. The market rate was **7%**, and Lakeshore paid **$372,902**. Use the effective interest method; round to whole dollars.

exhibits.title: Year-end fair values
exhibits.content:
| Date | Fair value of the Harper bonds |
|---|---:|
| Dec 31, Year 1 | 378,000 |
| Dec 31, Year 2 | 390,000 |

No credit losses are expected.

parts.prompt: Report the Year 1 amounts under each classification.

rows.label: If classified HTM — Dec 31, Year 1 balance sheet amount
rows.explanation: HTM is carried at amortized cost.

rows.label: If classified AFS — Dec 31, Year 1 balance sheet amount
rows.explanation: AFS is carried at fair value.

rows.label: If classified AFS — where does the Year 1 unrealized loss go?
rows.explanation: Non-credit unrealized losses on AFS debt securities go to OCI.

rows.label: If classified trading — where does the Year 1 unrealized loss go?
rows.explanation: Trading securities' fair value changes flow through net income.

parts.prompt: Assume AFS. Record the December 31, Year 2 fair value adjustment (a valuation account is used; its Year 1 balance was a $1,005 credit).
parts.explanation: Required Year 2 balance = 390,000 − 385,535 = 4,465 debit. Existing balance = 1,005 credit (378,000 − 379,005). Adjustment = 4,465 + 1,005 = **5,470** debit, credited to OCI.
